structural_ledger_policy.classification: Conservative declared policy; not an observed customer ledger.
structural_ledger_policy.eligibility: Apply only to eligible ordinary shares held at the event, with ownership/settlement and excluded-share status reconciled. Any unsettled ownership mismatch remains unresolved.
structural_ledger_policy.event: After confirmed completion, reduce eligible tradable share units to zero and create a separate merger-claim lot of the same entitlement units; face claim=95*units. Preserve original lot basis and event provenance. This is a corporate action, not a sale fill or cash dividend.
structural_ledger_policy.resolution: Transfer receivable to spendable settled cash only on separately evidenced broker receipt/availability, with any documented withholding or charges reconciled. Cash receipt reduces the claim by the same amount; no double counting.
structural_ledger_policy.unknown_credit_policy: Keep the claim locked for the entire unresolved interval, including the study endpoint; assign no automatic T+1/T+2, October16, October20 or fixed-delay credit. Do not turn the claim into idle cash.
structural_ledger_policy.valuation: Use contractual face amount 95*entitled units as the explicitly declared receivable carrying-value convention after completed conversion. It is not an observed trade or customer cash balance. Display receivable and settled cash separately, assign zero reinvestment capacity to the claim, and do not accrue cash interest. This resolves economic entitlement under the stated convention without pretending to observe settlement.

guard_policy.OTC_new_entry: No new entry under the proposed U.S.-listed-stock universe.
guard_policy.OTC_transition: On March28 update historical symbol/venue using the common CUSIP without creating a sale, cash receipt or share cancellation. Do not back-label pre-March28 history as OTC.
guard_policy.account_path: A marked-holding endpoint after OTC trading resumes may be evaluable under this proxy. Complete daily NAV/drawdown through the unpriced halt remains unavailable unless a separately declared stale-mark or valuation convention is explicitly reported as such. Neither unpriced days nor unexecuted exits may be silently omitted.
guard_policy.existing_holdings: Retain quantity and basis through the halt. Preserve the last supported quote only as a separately labeled stale reference; qualified_current_mark=null and executable_exit=null during March10-27. An unpriced holding remains in the ledger rather than disappearing or becoming cash.
guard_policy.held_OTC_exit: Valuation and sale are distinct. Use an available March28-May31 matched vendor OTC daily close as a declared holding-value proxy. Do not create a sale or release cash from that mark. A simulated sale later requires a separately frozen delayed-exit/OTC execution and cost policy; it need not be a guaranteed actual customer fill, but cannot be introduced after evaluating returns.
guard_policy.terminal_handling: If a fixed horizon ends on a qualified March28-May31 OTC observation, report a terminal marked holding under the declared proxy, plus actual/cash-ledger balance separately. If the horizon ends during the halt or after available coverage, retain an unpriced holding and label that requested outcome unresolved. Do not require ultimate bankruptcy recovery outside a horizon that only needs a marked holding.
guard_policy.unfilled_orders: No simulated fill on or after the halt while Nasdaq remains halted/suspended; cancel an unfilled planned entry without changing cash or positions. Retain the event and the rejected-order reason.

prohibited_inferences: OCC option exercise settlement dates are not shareholder merger-credit dates.
Employee stock-award payment deadlines are not ordinary broker-held common-stock credit dates.
Nasdaq suspension dates are not automatically formal delisting dates.
A zero divCash field does not encode merger consideration or prove no capital entitlement.
Zero-volume or repeated bars are not valid zero-return observations; positive volume is not proof of regular exchange executability.
Stated stress values such as zero available value may be used only in a separately labeled risk scenario, never as historical recovery, price or performance.
